title: Someone Did My Laundry at 3 AM Every Night (Full Story)
script: Every night at 3 AM, someone ran the washing machine in my building's basement. One night I went down to catch them. The room was empty. Inside the machine was my gray hoodie, the one I lost months ago. On top was a note: I wash it every week so it stays soft for you. The handwriting was mine. I live alone. So I hid a camera. At 2:58, the door opened, and it was me. Same hoodie, eyes wide open. But my smartwatch said I was in bed, in deep sleep. Before she left, the girl in my hoodie looked straight into the camera and held up a note: Don't open the dryer yet. Three days later, I opened it. Inside, folded and warm, was everything I thought I'd lost this year. My keys. My mom's scarf. The birthday card she sent before she passed. And one last note, in my handwriting: You stopped taking care of yourself after Mom. So I did it for you. I'm the part of you that remembers. Now I do my laundry on Sunday afternoons, and the machine never runs at 3 AM. But every Sunday there's a new note on my fridge. It just says: Proud of you. Follow for more stories.
description: The complete 3 AM laundry mystery in one video. This is a fictional story.
